name: emit_profiling_analysis
description: Between the profiling answers and the auditor's pain points to produce a structured diagnosis: a narrative of the most important pain points, a cost estimate, a time estimate, and an action plan. Call this exactly once with the complete analysis.

pain_points_analysis.description: Markdown narrative analysing the most important pain points, ordered by impact, grounded in the profiling answers and the auditor's notes.

range_cop.description: Estimated cost range in Colombian pesos (COP), e.g. '30 a 80 millones COP'.

breakdown.description: Line items that make up the estimated cost.

confidence.description: Confidence in the cost estimate given the available context.

phases.description: Named phases of the estimated timeline.

confidence.description: Confidence in the time estimate given the available context.

duration_weeks.description: Estimated duration of the phase in weeks.

activities.description: Activities carried out in the phase.
